meta.title: Intake Estimate-to-Budget Mapping: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Open Intake Estimate-to-Budget Mapping and map the intake estimate to the PR budget
Sign in as a user without the Approver role and verify the action is refused or absent
Repeat the action as an Approver and verify it is available
Verify the tenant is Enterprise and determine whether RBAC configuration intentionally grants the action to other roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open Intake Estimate-to-Budget Mapping and map the intake estimate to the PR budget; Sign in as a user without the Approver role and verify the action is refused or absent; Repeat the action as an Approver and verify it is available; Verify the tenant is Enterprise and determine whether RBAC configuration intentionally grants the action to other roles

args.need: in the same Enterprise tenant, sign in as the non-Approver and then as an Approver, attempt Intake Estimate-to-Budget Mapping, and record whether the mapping action is refused or absent for the first user and available for the Approver

steps.note: The catalog cannot access this intake-mapping feature or switch between role-specific users.
Provides the closest available final assertion after the tester completes the role comparison, but does not assert the RBAC behavior itself.
